essential_subset: emit sqlite_tx_begin only at false-to-true sqlite3.Connection.in_transaction edge
emit commit_end and rollback_end on the existing connection lifecycle stream
bounded payload-free lifecycle parser for WAL attribution candidates
excluded_as_unrelated: application write-lock ordering and timeout exception changes

contract.identity_owner: existing open event: UUID connection_id, PID, caller, purpose, thread/task ownership
contract.transaction_state: sqlite_tx_begin then commit_end, rollback_end, or close
contract.classification: read_only connection mode supports only READ_TRANSACTION_CANDIDATE; no active transaction proves a WAL pin
contract.duration: provenance parser derives transaction age from bounded event timestamps

bounded_storage.lifecycle_stream: existing rotating JSONL, default 10 MiB current plus two 10 MiB backups = 30 MiB maximum per configured path
bounded_storage.provenance_read: tail-read maximum 4 MiB; no output file

worker_compatibility.creator_funding: already has bounded same-process open-connection snapshot, but no lifecycle parser composition
worker_compatibility.creator_resolution: has holder PID and same-process summary paths, but no lifecycle parser composition
worker_compatibility.decision: do not change worker liveness/restart behavior in this prerequisite; a later bounded composition can pass current checkpoint and holder inputs to the parser
